# Marketing and Communications

# Media Relations

NHTI works closely with journalists on stories about higher education, academics, and student life and success. We also provide examples of how NHTI faculty, students, and staff are making an impact. We have faculty from 70+ academic program areas who are experts in their fields and look forward to contributing to media stories.

For additional information on press releases or media inquiries, contact the Department of Marketing and Communications.

**NHTI Department of Marketing and Communications**

**Emily Marsh**  
College Director, Communications & Marketing  
603-230-4000 x 4137  
[\[email protected\]](https://www.nhti.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#056060686477766d456666766b6d2b606170)  
Office location: Student Center 232

## Urgent Press Inquiries Fall 2026

During a period of time in fall 2026, Emily Marsh will be unavailable. If you are not able to reach NHTI’s marketing department, please reach out to the contact below

**Liz Lawton**  
Executive Assistant  
603-271-6484 x 4167  
[\[email protected\]](https://www.nhti.edu/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c7a2aba6b0b3a8a987a4a4b4a9afe9a2a3b2)

[NHTI Press Releases](https://www.nhti.edu/news)

## Marketing Resources

NHTI promotes a recognizable brand and identity for our college in our region, across our state, and beyond. Consistent reinforcement of our brand and identity can establish and perpetuate our presence in today’s communication-oriented world.

If you’re working on a project or representing NHTI in print or digital communications, contact the Department of Marketing and Communications.
